packets.title: 10 Day Finland Itinerary
packets.summary: Meghan's 10-day winter Finland itinerary: Ivalo Days 1-2 (glass igloos, reindeer farm, northern lights), Levi Days 2-5 (skiing, spa), Muonio Days 5-7 (reindeer rides, dog sledding, Särkitunturi hike), Ruka Days 7-10 (night skiing, Oulanka National Park).

items.name: Ivalo - Wilderness Hotels Lapland glass igloos
items.details: Fly into Ivalo, pick up rental car. 2 nights in glass igloo cabins at Wilderness Hotels Lapland. Tours: Sami reindeer farm visit, northern lights hunting.

items.name: Levi - skiing and spa
items.details: Drive to Levi. Stay at Levin Iglut and Northern Lights Ranch. Activities: skiing/snowboarding, spa day at Levi Foxfires.

items.name: Muonio - Torassieppi Eco Reindeer Resort
items.details: Drive to Muonio. Stay at Torassieppi Eco Reindeer Resort. Tours: reindeer rides, dog sledding, northern lights hunting. Self-guided hike up Särkitunturi at sunset.

items.name: Ruka - night skiing and Oulanka National Park
items.details: Drive to Ruka. Stay in hotel or Airbnb in town. Activities: night skiing at the ski resort, visit Oulanka National Park. Allow time to drive back to Ivalo for flight out.

packets.destination: Costa Rica (San José, La Fortuna, Isla Tortuga, Uvita)
packets.summary: Darren's 7-day Costa Rica route: San José 1 night, La Fortuna 3 days (volcano, hot springs, waterfalls), Isla Tortuga beach day trip, Uvita 2 days (waterfalls, Whale's Tail, ocean views). Rented a car and drove the whole way.

items.name: San José
items.details: 1 night in San José at the start of the 7-day itinerary.

items.name: La Fortuna - volcano, hot springs, waterfalls
items.details: 3 days in La Fortuna: volcano, hot springs, waterfalls.

items.name: Isla Tortuga - beach day trip
items.details: Beach day trip to Isla Tortuga.

items.name: Uvita - waterfalls, Whale's Tail, ocean views
items.details: 2 days in Uvita: waterfalls, Whale's Tail, ocean views.

packets.title: 15-Day Ionian Islands Itinerary (Corfu, Paxos, Lefkada)
packets.summary: Sophie's 15-day Ionian route: Corfu 7 days (Corfu Town, boat trips, Porto Timoni, southern beaches, Pantokrator), Paxos 3 days (Day 1 arrival, Day 2 boat circle, Day 3 scooter explore), Lefkada 5 days (west coast beaches, Karya village, sunsets, boat tours).

items.name: Corfu - Corfu Town and island highlights
items.details: 7 days on Corfu. Corfu Town alleys and Venetian vibe. Boat rental in Liapades or Paleokastritsa for turquoise bays. Hike to Porto Timoni via Afionas. Southern beaches: Halikouna, Marathias, Notos, Petriti. Erimitis nature reserve, Kassiopi, Akoli. Pantokrator summit, Old Perithia lunch. Aqualand, Moonlight Cinema beach cinema. Dinners at Ambelonas, Etrusco, village taverns.

items.name: Paxos - Day 1 arrival
items.details: Ferry from Corfu Town to Paxos (or bus to Lefkimmi then ferry). Day 1: arrival and slow exploring, chill at an organised beach.

items.name: Paxos - Day 2 boat circle
items.details: Day 2: rent a boat, circle the island, hidden caves and bays, Voutoumi beach. Dock in Lakka, Loggos, or Gaios for lunch.

items.name: Paxos - Day 3 scooter explore
items.details: Day 3: explore by scooter or car. Colourful churches, olive groves, beaches. Walk down to Erimitis beach.

items.name: Lefkada - west coast beaches
items.details: 5 days on Lefkada. Ferry from Paxos (3x weekly, Lefkada Palace). West coast beaches: Kathisma, Milos (hike from Agios Nikitas or boat taxi), Egremni, Porto Katsiki. Boat tours from Vasiliki. Karya village lunch under plane trees. Sunset spots: Rachi, Amente, Utopia. Paragliding. Boat tour around surrounding islands. Lefkada Town evening stroll. Avali beach.

packets.title: 7-Day Switzerland Itinerary
packets.summary: Min's 7-day Switzerland itinerary (detailed on minywander.com blog, linked from TikTok): Lucerne 1 night (Day 1 arrival via Zurich, Old Town), Grindelwald 3 nights (Jungfrau region: Lauterbrunnen, Murren, Gimmelwald, Brienz), Montreux 2 nights (Gruyeres, GoldenPass Belle Epoque Train). Scenic trains, gondolas, easy hikes.

items.name: Lucerne - Old Town
items.details: Arrive Zurich, train to Lucerne (1 hour). 1 night in Lucerne. Explore Old Town (Altstadt): Weinmarkt Square, Chapel Bridge, lakeside charm. Day trip option: Mount Pilatus.

items.name: Grindelwald - Jungfrau region base
items.details: 3 nights in Grindelwald. Luzern-Interlaken Express scenic train. Explore: Lauterbrunnen, Winteregg, Murren, Gimmelwald. Grindelwald-First, Lake Bachalpsee. Brienz Rothorn Railway, Brienz Lake cruise, Interlaken.

items.name: Montreux - Gruyeres and GoldenPass
items.details: 2 nights in Montreux. Visit Gruyeres (fondue). GoldenPass Belle Epoque Train scenic ride.

packets.title: 2-Week Sicily Itinerary
packets.destination: Sicily, Italy (Trapani, Castellammare, Scala dei Turchi, Ragusa, Taormina, Cefalù, Palermo)
packets.summary: dwanderess's 2-week Sicily summer itinerary with smart bases: Trapani 3 days (Erice, Favignana, Levanzo), Castellammare del Golfo 2 days (Grotta delle Colombe, Tonnara di Scopello), Scala dei Turchi + Punta Bianca 1-2 days, Ragusa 2 days (Noto, Marzamemi), Taormina 2 days (Isola Bella), Cefalù 2 days (La Rocca), Palermo 1 day (Casa Professa).

items.name: Trapani - old town, Erice, Favignana, Levanzo
items.details: 3 days in Trapani. Wander old town, drive to medieval village of Erice (20 mins). Day trips by ferry to Favignana and Levanzo islands.

items.name: Castellammare del Golfo - Grotta delle Colombe, Scopello
items.details: 2 days. Visit Grotta delle Colombe and the epic stairs (half-day). Tonnara di Scopello (book tickets in advance). Dinner in Scopello town.

items.name: Scala dei Turchi + Punta Bianca
items.details: 1-2 days. Scala dei Turchi and Punta Bianca (about 2 hrs drive). Fit both in one long day or stretch to two.

items.name: Ragusa - baroque, Noto, Marzamemi
items.details: 2 days in Ragusa. Baroque architecture. Day trip to Noto and Marzamemi for architecture and coastal sunset.

items.name: Taormina - cobbled streets, Isola Bella
items.details: 2 days in Taormina. Cobbled streets, local boutiques, turquoise beaches, especially Isola Bella.

items.name: Cefalù - medieval charm, La Rocca hike
items.details: 2 days in Cefalù. Medieval charm, long beach time, hike La Rocca for epic views.

items.name: Palermo - streets, cathedrals, Casa Professa
items.details: 1 day in Palermo before flying out. Explore streets, cathedrals, Casa Professa Church.

items.name: Winery tour: Gilchrist Farm Winery and Brengman Family Winery
items.details: Take a winery tour; get a charcuterie board at Brengman Family Winery.

items.name: Middle Coast Brewing
items.details: End the night back in Traverse City for dinner; noted gluten-free selection and mocktails.

packets.title: Cape Kamui Day Trip Guide
packets.summary: Taylor's full-day Cape Kamui guide: rental car or GetYourGuide tour from Sapporo, free entry and parking, and the Path of Charenka hike to the viewing platform.

items.name: Rental car pickup in Sapporo
items.details: Easiest access is by rental car from Sapporo (about 2.5 hrs) or Otaru (1.5 hrs).

items.name: Path of Charenka hike
items.details: 20-25 minute scenic walk from the parking lot along the coast; pack a jacket, it is windy.

items.name: Cape Kamui viewing platform
items.details: Viewing platform overlooking the ocean and offshore rocks; free entry, open year-round, free parking.

items.name: GetYourGuide full-day guided tour from Sapporo
items.details: Guided tour option for non-drivers visiting Cape Kamui.
